title: [STORY] Implement paginate() utility for list pagination
description: As a developer I can call paginate(items, page, page_size) to receive a dict with the requested page slice plus pagination metadata (total_pages, total_items, page, page_size). The function must handle edge cases: empty list, page beyond last page, page_size of 1.

acceptance_criteria: paginate([], 1, 10) returns {page:1, page_size:10, total_pages:0, total_items:0, items:[]}
